_note: Seasonal and event themes (FR-THEME-001/005, docs/06 §4.4, docs/14 §12). Names are the owner's (supplement §30); HEX values are TEMPORARY placeholders until the owner's design (OWN-14, D-3). The accent is the seed: the whole 6-token set comes from the generator (docs/06 §4.2) with its contrast guarantees. «viz» — the visualiser palette (3–5 colours). «effect» — the linked live effect for «По сезону» (docs/14 §13, supplement §31), «night_effect» — the same at night (a summer night — fireflies); «night_dayparts» — which dayparts of the clock (context.json) count as night until the weather's is_day (T5.15). Events without a palette use the season's theme.
_note_weather: «По реальной погоде» (supplement §31, docs/14 §13.1): precipitation and fog decide; dry weather in autumn and spring — leaves and petals; cloudy — cloud shadows; clear by day — motes, a clear summer night — the season's night effect (fireflies), another clear night — nothing.
